integrity: The theorem has a constructive all-size proof; finite checks are not infinite certificates. Known block-type orbit classification is not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Orbit recovery uses the entire strict refinement relation, not the cover graph; three rounds are not proved optimal; no identification among arbitrary finite posets is claimed. Finite checks corroborate, rather than replace, the proof. Specialized earlier literature could contain related coverage.
title: Three-round orbit recovery for finite partition lattices
